controls.explanation: What the metal is; the header states it, so it must match the colour chosen.
controls.label: Finish

controls.explanation: The metal's reflectance: pale grey for aluminium, warmer for bronze or brass.
controls.label: Metal colour

controls.explanation: How many brush streaks fit end to end along one tile; fewer means longer streaks.
controls.label: Streak length

controls.explanation: How many brush streaks stack across one tile.
controls.label: Streak fineness

controls.explanation: How many hairlines fit end to end along one tile.
controls.label: Hairline length

controls.explanation: How many hairlines stack across one tile.
controls.label: Hairline fineness

controls.explanation: Where the metal face sits in the height range.
controls.label: Surface height

controls.explanation: How deep the brush streaks are.
controls.label: Streak depth

controls.explanation: How deep the hairlines are.
controls.label: Hairline depth

controls.explanation: How far the sheet departs from flat.
controls.label: Waviness

controls.explanation: Broad, faint variation in the metal's colour.
controls.label: Tone variation

controls.explanation: How much the brush streaks vary in brightness.
controls.label: Streak contrast

controls.explanation: How much the hairlines vary in brightness.
controls.label: Hairline contrast

controls.explanation: How blurry reflections are, in thousandths.
controls.label: Roughness

controls.explanation: How much the streaks vary in roughness.
controls.label: Streak roughness

controls.explanation: How much the hairlines vary in roughness.
controls.label: Hairline roughness

controls.explanation: Higher means fewer handling marks.
controls.label: Handling-mark rarity

controls.explanation: How much darker a handling mark is.
controls.label: Mark darkening

controls.explanation: How much a handling mark blurs reflections.
controls.label: Mark dullness

controls.explanation: How metallic the surface still reads under a mark, in thousandths.
controls.label: Mark film

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
